categories.main_business_segments: Xiaomi Corporation operates primarily in two main business segments: the Smartphone × AIoT segment, which includes smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, internet services, and related businesses; and the Smart EV and other new initiatives segment, which encompasses smart electric vehicles and related businesses. The company focuses on delivering innovative technology products and services within these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes foundational core technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, and smart manufacturing. It develops proprietary technologies such as Xiaomi HyperOS 2 operating system with HyperCore, HyperConnect, and HyperAI, and invests heavily in R&D with over 42,000 patents worldwide. Xiaomi also operates smart factories with high automation and digitalization, including self-developed manufacturing equipment and AI-driven production systems, and integrates AI extensively into product design, manufacturing, and services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xiaomi serves a broad customer base including individual consumers globally, with a focus on premium and mid-range smartphone users, IoT device users, and smart EV customers. Its internet services target global users with over 700 million monthly active users. The company has significant market presence in mainland China and overseas markets including Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and India, serving both retail consumers and ecosystem partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: Xiaomi operates globally with key markets in mainland China and overseas regions such as Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, India, and Latin America. The company has established extensive offline retail stores in China and service centers in multiple countries. Its manufacturing and R&D centers are primarily in China, with smart factories in Beijing and Wuhan, and it maintains a global supply chain and investment portfolio.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiaomi operates primarily downstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and retailer of consumer electronics and smart devices, including smartphones, IoT products, and smart EVs. It also engages in upstream activities through investments in battery manufacturing, materials, and energy storage sectors. The company manages a comprehensive supply chain with tiered supplier management, CSR audits, and digital supply chain systems to ensure quality and sustainability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing foundational core technologies, especially AI, IoT, and 5G, to build an integrated 'Human × Car × Home' ecosystem. It prioritizes R&D investment, with a 25.9% increase in 2024 to RMB24.1 billion, and employs over 21,000 R&D personnel. Xiaomi emphasizes AI integration across products and operations, development of proprietary operating systems, smart manufacturing, and sustainable innovation, aiming to lead in cutting-edge technology and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Xiaomi generates revenue primarily through product sales of smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, and smart EVs. It also earns significant income from internet services, including advertising revenue. The company employs a hardware business model with a net profit margin pledge not exceeding 5%, supplemented by service revenues and licensing. Additionally, it engages in investments and share repurchases to enhance shareholder value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiaomi is positioned as a top-three global smartphone manufacturer with a 13.8% market share in 2024, competing with major players like Apple and Samsung. It holds leading positions in wearables and smart home appliances in China and globally. The smart EV segment is emerging, with Xiaomi rapidly scaling deliveries and technology development. The company differentiates through innovation, premiumization, and ecosystem integration, maintaining strong competitiveness in emerging and established markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Xiaomi reported record revenue of RMB365.9 billion in 2024, a 35.0% year-over-year increase, with adjusted net profit reaching RMB27.2 billion, up 41.3%. The Smartphone × AIoT segment accounted for 91% of revenue, while smart EV and new initiatives contributed 9%. The company has a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB403.2 billion and a net cash position. It continues to invest heavily in R&D and smart manufacturing, supporting sustained growth and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiaomi emphasizes delivering amazing products with honest prices, integrating innovative technology to improve users' lives. Its value proposition includes advanced AI-driven ecosystem integration ('Human × Car × Home'), premium product features, and extensive IoT connectivity. The company differentiates through proprietary technologies, high automation in manufacturing, sustainable practices, and comprehensive after-sales services, aiming to provide superior user experience, quality, and accessibility worldwide.
